dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast light-colored curvilinear perimeters forming complex 'O' and 'C' shaped structures against a dark background. The edges exhibit sharp intensity transitions with jagged, fractal-like boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily in the anterior dorsal region, often appearing as nodes at the intersections of light-colored textural lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest anterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, horizontal cluster of high-intensity orange-red pixels is present at the anterior-most terminus, exhibiting a distinct spectral contrast to the grayscale pelt.
other_distinctive_markers: A pronounced textural gradient is visible, where the high-contrast macro-annuli pattern on the anterior section transitions into a more homogenous, low-intensity dark field toward the posterior.
